question: Identify the largest phylum in the animal kingdom.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arthropoda**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Arthropoda** is the largest phylum in the animal kingdom.
 
• This phylum includes diverse groups such as insects, arachnids, myriapods, and crustaceans.
